// diagnostic

E0774

`{entry}` in `{marker}`'s template row is outside `Marker.expand`'s row

What

`{entry}` in `{marker}`'s template row is outside `Marker.expand`'s row

Why

A marker's template runs inside the compiler, where its row may name `Meta.Generate` and nothing else; reading the program needs no effect

Fix

Remove `{entry}`: write `-[Meta.Generate]>` for a template that writes code, or `-[]>` for one that only reads

Worked example

First UI snapshot mentioning E0774: tests/ui/effects/marker_row_outside_contract_is_e0774.stderr.
